summary.text: Jonathan Almond is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 73 who has served since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An accountant by training, he is listed by the General Assembly as a controller.

paragraphs.text: Almond was born in Charlotte, North Carolina, graduated from Piedmont High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte in 2010.
His career experience includes working in accounting.
Almond assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2025, succeeding Diamond Staton-Williams.
The General Assembly's website lists his county as Cabarrus and his occupation as controller.
In the 2025-2026 session he is a member of the Appropriations, Appropriations, Health and Human Services, Election Law, Insurance, Judiciary 3, and Regulatory Reform committees.
